knowledge.purpose: Rich long-form body content (Markdown or sanitized HTML) rendered with proper typographic vertical rhythm — the first-party equivalent of a typography/prose plugin, styled entirely from theme tokens
useCases: Article or blog post body bound to a CMS field
Documentation page section with headings, lists, code, and links
Long terms-of-service / policy copy that needs readable rhythm
Documentation with tables, nested steps and code samples a reader copies (copyButton: true)
antiPatterns: A single short line or label — use text.text
Untrusted third-party HTML expecting full passthrough — prose sanitizes to a conservative allowlist (no script/iframe/event handlers)
knowledge.implementation:
Further anti-patterns:
- Interactive form markup — prose strips form/input/button; use form.* blocks

Further use cases:
- Any multi-paragraph rich text where individual text blocks would be tedious
- Code samples: a fenced block names its language after the fence (```ts, ```bash, ```json …); with copyButton: true each block gets a copy button that reads ui.copy / ui.copied (or copyLabel / copiedLabel)

props.name: content
props.description: Markdown string (preferred) OR a raw HTML fragment. Markdown supports headings (#, each with an anchor id from its text, unique in the block), nested lists (indent an item under another), GitHub-style tables (| a | b | over |---|---:|, the colons aligning a column), **bold**, *italic*, `code`, fenced code with its language after the fence (```ts — its keywords, strings, numbers and comments coloured from the theme), > blockquote, links and images. A link to an app page (/setup) or an in-page anchor (#options) goes through the app's routing; an outside address is unchanged. HTML is sanitized to a conservative tag/attribute allowlist. Bindable to a data source.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Reading-column max width. Numbers → px; strings (e.g. '65ch', '720px') pass through. Defaults to a readable measure via the layout container token.

props.name: copyButton
props.description: A copy button on each code block, which copies that block's code and announces it. Its words are copyLabel and copiedLabel, else the app's ui.copy and ui.copied.

props.name: copyLabel
props.description: The copy button's word. Unset: the app's ui.copy. Write it in the app's language.

props.name: copiedLabel
props.description: Shown and announced once the code reached the clipboard. Unset: the app's ui.copied.
